title: Setting Up Internet and Utilities
meta: B2 · 约 310 词 · 场景：开通宽带与安装爽约

lines.en: Thanks for calling. My name's Oliver. How can I help you today?
lines.zh: 感谢来电，我是奥利弗。今天有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi, I've just moved into a new flat, and I'd like to __sign up for__ home ==broadband==.
lines.zh: 你好，我刚搬进新房子，想办家庭宽带。

lines.en: Sure. We have a one gig plan at forty-five dollars a month, or two gig at fifty-five.
lines.zh: 好的。我们有千兆套餐每月四十五块，两千兆每月五十五块。

lines.en: **What's the difference in practice? We mostly stream videos, and I work from home sometimes.**
lines.zh: 实际用起来有什么区别？我们主要看视频，我偶尔在家办公。

lines.en: Honestly, one gig is plenty for a family. Two gig only matters if lots of devices are downloading at once.
lines.zh: 说实话，一个家庭千兆完全够用。只有很多设备同时下载时，两千兆才有意义。

lines.en: Okay, one gig then. How long is the ==contract==, and is there an ==installation fee==?
lines.zh: 好，那就千兆。合约多长？有安装费吗？

lines.en: It's a twenty-four month contract. Installation is free, and the ==router== is included.
lines.zh: 合约二十四个月。安装免费，送路由器。

lines.en: What happens if I need to ==cancel== early? We might move overseas next year.
lines.zh: 如果要提前解约怎么办？我们明年可能搬去国外。

lines.en: There's an early termination charge, but it goes down every month. I'll email you the details.
lines.zh: 会有提前解约费，但每个月递减。我把详情发到您邮箱。

lines.en: **That's fine. When's the earliest you can send someone to install it?**
lines.zh: 可以。最早什么时候能派人来安装？

lines.en: This Saturday, between nine and one. Someone will need to be home.
lines.zh: 这周六，九点到一点之间。家里需要有人。

lines.en: Hi, I had an installation booked for this morning, nine to one. It's now half past one, and __nobody's turned up__.
lines.zh: 你好，我约了今天上午九点到一点安装。现在已经一点半了，一个人都没来。

lines.en: I'm really sorry about that. Let me check. It says the technician couldn't get ==access== to the building.
lines.zh: 非常抱歉。我查一下。记录上说师傅进不了楼。

lines.en: That's strange. I was home all morning, and nobody called me.
lines.zh: 奇怪了。我整个上午都在家，也没人给我打电话。

lines.en: He may have been stopped by the ==security guard== downstairs. I do apologise.
lines.zh: 他可能被楼下保安拦住了。真的很抱歉。

lines.en: **I took the morning off for this. What can you do to make it right?**
lines.zh: 我为这事请了一上午假。你们打算怎么补救？

lines.en: I can rebook you for the first slot tomorrow morning and ==waive== your first month's fee.
lines.zh: 我可以帮您改约到明天上午第一个时段，并免掉第一个月的月费。

lines.en: Tomorrow works. Could you make sure he calls me when he arrives, so I can __let him in__?
lines.zh: 明天可以。能确保他到了给我打电话吗？我好下去接他进来。

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll add your mobile number to the job, and register him with security in advance.
lines.zh: 没问题。我会把您的手机号加到工单上，并提前帮他在保安处登记。

lines.en: Thanks. And could you __put that in writing__? An email would be fine.
lines.zh: 谢谢。这些能给我书面确认吗？发邮件就行。

lines.en: Of course. You'll get a ==confirmation== email within the hour.
lines.zh: 当然。一小时内您会收到确认邮件。

gist.q: 「你」最后选了什么套餐？合约条件是什么？
gist.a: 千兆宽带，每月四十五块，合约二十四个月，免安装费、送路由器；提前解约有逐月递减的违约费。

gist.q: 安装那天出了什么问题？客服怎么解释？
gist.a: 师傅到一点半都没来；客服说记录显示师傅进不了楼，可能被楼下保安拦了。

gist.q: 客服给出了哪些补救措施？
gist.a: 改约到明天上午第一个时段，免第一个月月费，把手机号加到工单并提前在保安处登记，再发一封确认邮件。

dictation: What's the difference in practice? We mostly stream videos, and I work from home sometimes.
What happens if I need to cancel early? We might move overseas next year.
I took the morning off for this. What can you do to make it right?
Thanks. And could you put that in writing? An email would be fine.

prompts.q: 你打电话给电力公司开户。说明搬家日期、地址类型，问需要什么材料、押金多少、多久能开通。
prompts.ref: Hi, I'm moving into a condo next Monday, and I'd like to open a new electricity and water account. What documents do I need? I have my passport, employment pass, and the tenancy agreement. Is there a deposit for foreigners, and roughly how much is it? And will the power be on by the time I move in?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我下周一搬进一个公寓，想开新的水电账户。需要什么材料？我有护照、工作准证和租房合同。外国人需要交押金吗，大概多少？我入住的时候电能通上吗？

prompts.q: 宽带装好后晚上经常断网。打电话投诉，说明情况，并要求上门检查或换路由器。
prompts.ref: Hi, my broadband was installed last week, but it keeps dropping in the evenings, usually between eight and eleven. I've already restarted the router several times, and it doesn't help. I work from home, so this is a real problem. Could you send a technician to check the line, or replace the router?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我的宽带上周刚装好，但晚上老是断，一般在八点到十一点之间。我已经重启路由器好几次了，没用。我在家办公，这真的很影响。能派师傅来检查线路，或者换个路由器吗？
